— 202 Returned if the request to delete the folder was accepted.
403
Returned if you do not have user permissions to delete a folder with the given ID. For more information,
see Roles and Permissions.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable Web App Scanning.
